ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive sound feels less appealing right now than the melodic heaviness I have been exploring.

ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic rock sound interests me, but I would choose something heavier this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy riffs and strong hooks fit my listening, though other albums here appeal more today.
ItemID: NA; Title: ...And Justice For All; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intricate metal arrangements appeal to me, but I am not choosing this album on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: We Are Not Alone Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its melodic heaviness because I have been listening to albums like One Day Remains and The Reason.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently explored Ten Thousand Fists, I would choose another album by Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its mix of aggression and melody fits, but I already have several stronger choices this time.
